claims.claim: Workflow execution protections for GitHub Actions, previously in public preview, became generally available for GitHub Enterprise, organizations, and repositories on 2026-09-17.
General availability of workflow execution protections adds workflow file targeting, insights for auditing rule impact, and a REST API to manage execution protections as code.
Workflow execution protections address pull_request_target vulnerabilities such as Pwn Requests through new secure defaults.

Enterprise administrators can now enforce GitHub Advanced Security configurations so organization and repository administrators cannot override enterprise-level settings, with three enforcement levels available.

GitHub Copilot budget increase requests are generally available for Copilot Business and Enterprise plans under usage-based billing, letting members request more budget on hitting a limit and owners approve or adjust it in place; the feature is unavailable for enterprises with managed users.
Microsoft Foundry added a public preview of network egress controls for hosted agents, announced 2026-09-18.
Enable and disable controls for Microsoft Foundry agents in Agent 365 reached general availability on 2026-09-18.
A public preview of PostgreSQL skills and an MCP plugin for Azure Database for PostgreSQL was announced 2026-09-16.
The Azure DevOps Blog published no new posts inside the 2026-09-14 to 2026-09-20 reporting window; its most recent post was published 2026-09-10.
GitHub Copilot budget increase requests overlap closely with the existing 2026-09-13 GitHub Copilot FinOps blog post, reducing the novelty of a dedicated article on that topic this week.

Workflow execution protections GA is the strongest candidate for a full article this week because it combines high enterprise impact, direct CSA relevance to DevOps governance, and strong novelty versus existing blog coverage.
